title: Rejection probability as a pair average
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $n$. The rejection probability of the tester that samples two coordinates independently and uniformly and accepts exactly when their values agree equals the average, over all ordered pairs of coordinates $(i,j)$, of $1$ when $w(i)\ne w(j)$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
